items.text_en: Holm oak, carob, almond, fig, olive.
Myrtle, strawberry tree, wild pistachio, laurel, juniper.
Sage, thyme, oregano, rosemary, immortelle, rocket, chamomile.
items.text_hr: Kadulja, majčina dušica, origano, ružmarin, smilje, rikula, kamilica.

items.text_en: Clover for nitrogen, buhač as insect repellent, mulch from everything cut.
items.text_hr: Djetelina za dušik, buhač protiv kukaca, malč od svega što se reže.

items.text_en: Tamarisk against salt and wind, closest to the sea.
items.text_hr: Tamaris protiv soli i vjetra, najbliže moru.
